response.summary: Four of five claims are Supported. Data Center revenue grew year over year in consecutive quarters (up 117% in Q2 fiscal 2027), though the company warns faster product cadence may make revenue volatile. Revenue and receivables are concentrated in a few customers. Export controls are restricting revenue: a $4.5 billion H20 charge, with licensed China sales still small. Supplier dependence is confirmed; only two foundries are named. Gross margin is Mixed evidence: 75.0% in Q2 against 72.4% a year earlier, but flat sequentially and down to 71.1% for fiscal 2026, so expansion is not established. For the overweight decision, growth supports it while concentration and export-control risk weigh against it.
next_steps: Check whether gross margin moves beyond the 75% plateau in the next quarter's guidance and results.
Track the share of revenue from the largest direct customers and any change in receivables concentration.
Monitor H200 license progress and any revenue from China, and the effect of export controls on other markets.
Review how the faster product cadence could affect revenue volatility and supplier capacity.
